context: A married couple plans a holiday-season family weekend
purpose: Teach: 池袋/前方/ブロード/ゴールド/シルバー/サンタ/ニート/登校

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、今年のクリスマスは池袋のホテルに泊まって、家族で過ごさない?
lines.en: Hey, for Christmas this year, shall we stay at a hotel in Ikebukuro as a family?
lines.style: Warm, suggestive, casually inviting tone with rising intonation.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいね。でも先の予定がまだ読めないんだよな、年末の仕事。前方の渋滞も心配だし。
lines.en: Sounds good. But I can't see my schedule clearly yet — year-end work. And traffic ahead worries me too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant, working-dad register with a small sigh.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 週末だけでも大丈夫。子どもたちにサンタからのプレゼント、一緒に渡したいの。
lines.en: Just a weekend is fine. I want us together when the kids get their gifts from Santa.
lines.style: Gentle, motherly, slightly pleading with affectionate warmth.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 了解。ホテルのプラン、ゴールドとシルバーがあるみたいだけど、どっちにする?
lines.en: Got it. The hotel seems to have Gold and Silver plans — which one should we go with?
lines.style: Practical, decision-oriented, mildly playful comparing the options.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ゴールドの方が広いし、Wi-Fiも速くてブロードバンド完備って書いてあったよ。
lines.en: The Gold one is bigger, and it said the Wi-Fi is fast with full broadband too.
lines.style: Informed, matter-of-fact, lightly persuasive with a small smile.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: じゃあそれで。あ、月曜は子どもたち、登校できるように夜には帰ろう。
lines.en: Let's go with that, then. Oh, we should head back Monday night so the kids can go to school.
lines.style: Decisive, fatherly, mindful of routines with practical care.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もちろん。ニートの息子みたいにダラダラ連休延ばしちゃダメよ、お父さん。
lines.en: Of course. We can't lazily drag out the holiday like some NEET son, dear.
lines.style: Teasing, lightly scolding wife tone with an affectionate playful jab.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ひどいな(笑)。よし、今夜予約しよう。家族みんなで楽しもう。
lines.en: That's harsh (laugh). Alright, let's book it tonight. Let's all enjoy it as a family.
lines.style: Amused, mock-wounded, then warmly resolved family-man tone.
